title: How to Grieve Whilst Building your Career

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 各位心理学家，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱之外的收入，那会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆和梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止日期为11月16日星期一晚上10点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Is there ever a wrong time to pursue your professional career in psychology or to advance it beyond its current state?
sentences.zh: 追求心理学专业职业生涯，或者在现有基础上更进一步，是否会有所谓的“错误时机”？

sentences.en: That is the question.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的问题。

sentences.en: There could be a variety of reasons why you or others around you might be telling you that it could be the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 你或周围的人可能会出于各种原因告诉你，现在可能不是合适的时机。

sentences.en: And today we are taking a closer look at that with personal insight and reflections from my gueSt.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将结合我嘉宾的个人见解和反思，深入探讨这个问题。

sentences.en: It's a wonderfully powerful, evocative episode.
sentences.zh: 这是一集非常强大且引人深思的节目。

sentences.en: I hope you find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得它很有用。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I am Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: As I said in the intro, we are looking at whether there is ever such a thing as a wrong time to pursue your career in psychology or to progress it beyond where you are currently.
sentences.zh: 正如我在开场白中所说，我们正在探讨追求心理学职业生涯或在现有基础上更进一步，是否真的存在所谓的“错误时机”。

sentences.en: And we are talking with Jasmine Thompson who lost her mum within the last 12 months and it is a really, really special episode.
sentences.zh: 我们采访了茉莉·汤普森，她在过去12个月内失去了母亲，这是一集非常、非常特别的节目。

sentences.en: I cry, she cries, we do talk about grief quite openly and how it's affected us and our practice.
sentences.zh: 我哭了，她也哭了，我们非常坦诚地谈论了悲伤，以及它如何影响了我们和我们的执业。

sentences.en: And I hope you can look after yourself if you are struggling right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你现在正处于挣扎中，希望你能照顾好自己。

sentences.en: If this does feel a little bit too raw, you might choose to watch or listen at a later stage.
sentences.zh: 如果这让你觉得有点难以承受，你可以选择稍后再观看或收听。

sentences.en: But it feels like a really important conversation to have.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得这是一场非常重要的对话。

sentences.en: And so I hope you do find it useful, even if you are not currently grieving.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望即使你目前没有经历悲伤，也能从中受益。

sentences.en: I think it will help you to really develop some insight, some understanding to what people you might be working with might be experiencing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这会帮助你培养一些洞察力，理解你可能正在共事的人们正在经历什么。

sentences.en: And maybe to think about, you know, this being a useful episode for if things happen in future.
sentences.zh: 也许可以思考一下，如果未来发生类似的事情，这一集会很有用。

sentences.en: I would love to know what you think to the episode.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道你对这一集的看法。

sentences.en: Do please come and connect with me on social media where I'm Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 请务必在社交媒体上与我联系，我在所有平台上的名字都是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: And also come and join the free Facebook group, the Aspiring Psychologist Community with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 也欢迎加入我们的免费Facebook群组：玛丽安·特伦特博士的“有抱负的心理学家社区”。

sentences.en: But yeah, please look after yourself.
sentences.zh: 总之，请照顾好自己。

sentences.en: I hope you find this a really helpful episode and I'll look forward to catching up with you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这一集很有帮助，期待在节目之后与你交流。

sentences.en: I just want to welcome along our guest for today, Jasmine Thompson.
sentences.zh: 我想欢迎今天的嘉宾，茉莉·汤普森。

sentences.en: Hi, Jas.
sentences.zh: 嗨，贾兹。

sentences.en: Hiya, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm okay, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for asking.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的关心。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你怎么样？

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm good, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我也很好，谢谢。

sentences.en: We were just talking about how it feels to be calling yourself an incoming trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我们刚才还在谈论，称呼自己为“准临床心理学家”是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Because as we record, it's the summer.
sentences.zh: 因为我们录制的时候是夏天。

sentences.en: But when this episode goes live, you're going to be days away from having that lanyard around your neck that actually says trainee clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但当这一集播出时，你离脖子上挂着写有“准临床心理学家”字样的挂绳只有几天之遥了。

sentences.en: So how is that feeling for you?
sentences.zh: 所以你现在感觉如何？

sentences.en: Oh, it's just crazy hearing you say that and knowing, you know, yeah, in a few months I'll be starting.
sentences.zh: 哦，听到你这么说，知道再过几个月我就要开始了，这简直太疯狂了。

sentences.en: It's been such a long time coming and, you know, everyone knows it's a bit of a relentless process.
sentences.zh: 这一路走来太漫长了，而且大家都知道，这是一个相当无情的过程。

sentences.en: Well, it can be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实可能是这样。

sentences.en: For me, it was quite challenging.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这相当具有挑战性。

sentences.en: So for it to be actually, I'm there and, as you said, seeing my name with incoming trainee clinical psychologist is just, it's surreal.
sentences.zh: 所以，真正走到这一步，正如你所说，看到我的名字后面写着“准临床心理学家”，感觉太不真实了。

sentences.en: But very grateful, very excited.
sentences.zh: 但我非常感激，也非常兴奋。

sentences.en: Oh, well, well done to you, because, you know, I know they do not give these golden tickets away lightly or easily.
sentences.zh: 哦，做得好，因为我知道他们不会轻易或随意地发放这些“金票”。

sentences.en: So it's absolutely well earned.
sentences.zh: 所以这是你应得的。

sentences.en: But, you know, the reason for us talking today is that there's a very special someone who you would have dearly loved to have been able to say,
sentences.zh: 但我们今天谈话的原因是，有一个非常特别的人，你一定非常希望能够告诉她这个消息，

sentences.en: God bless!
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑！

sentences.en: And they weren't there, were they?
sentences.zh: 但她不在了，对吧？

sentences.en: Do you want to tell us a little bit about what I'm talking about, Jazz?
sentences.zh: 贾兹，你想跟我们聊聊我指的是什么吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: And I think those watching, my eyes will go a bit glossy, but it happens.
sentences.zh: 我想观看节目的朋友们会看到我的眼睛有点湿润，但这很正常。

sentences.en: But my lovely mum sadly died a year ago, almost today.
sentences.zh: 我可爱的妈妈不幸在一年前去世了，几乎就是今天。

sentences.en: So in July last year, in 2023, she had cancer.
sentences.zh: 所以去年七月，也就是2023年，她患了癌症。

sentences.en: She first was diagnosed when I was actually 12, so around 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 她第一次被诊断出来时我才12岁，大约是15年前。

sentences.en: And it was always kind of in the background, but my mum was amazing because she never made it a huge part of our lives.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上一直存在于背景中，但我妈妈很了不起，因为她从未让它成为我们生活的核心部分。

sentences.en: She was amazing.
sentences.zh: 她太棒了。

sentences.en: She'd work through, she ran her own companies, so she worked through all her treatments.
sentences.zh: 她坚持工作，经营着自己的公司，所以她在整个治疗期间都在工作。

sentences.en: And it was always something that was happening in the background that didn't hugely impact us.
sentences.zh: 这总是背景中发生的事情，并没有对我们产生巨大的影响。

sentences.en: I think we were always very positive about the treatment she was getting.
sentences.zh: 我想我们对她接受的治疗一直非常积极。

sentences.en: But sadly, a year ago, she did have a terminal diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 但遗憾的是，一年前，她被诊断为晚期。

sentences.en: She got a brain tumour, which was unable to be treated.
sentences.zh: 她患了脑瘤，无法治疗。

sentences.en: And we found out about that around April, May time.
sentences.zh: 我们在四五月份左右得知了这个消息。

sentences.en: And so it gave her about three and a half months left.
sentences.zh: 所以她只剩下大约三个半月的时间了。

sentences.en: So it was, you know, the most challenging thing I think I'll ever go through.
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为这是我经历过的最具挑战性的事情。

sentences.en: But she was just incredible.
sentences.zh: 但她真的太不可思议了。

sentences.en: Her kind of motto and something she shouted from the rooftop was, every day is a gift.
sentences.zh: 她的座右铭，也是她经常挂在嘴边的一句话是：每一天都是一份礼物。

sentences.en: So she had her own company, Let's Reset, which was all about putting well-being in the centre of businesses that I set up with her a few years ago, kind of in lockdown.
sentences.zh: 她有自己的公司“Let's Reset”，致力于将幸福感置于商业中心，这是我几年前在封锁期间与她共同创立的。

sentences.en: So she kept on talking about that until the very, very end.
sentences.zh: 所以她一直谈论这个，直到生命的最后一刻。

sentences.en: So it's, yeah, it's very, very special.
sentences.zh: 所以，这真的很特别。

sentences.en: And becoming a clinical psychologist was something we always spoke about.
sentences.zh: 成为一名临床心理学家是我们一直谈论的事情。

sentences.en: I mean, when I started studying my undergrad, she started referring to me as a clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我开始读本科时，她就开始称我为临床心理学家了。

sentences.en: And I was like, Mum, I'm not one yet.
sentences.zh: 我说：妈妈，我还不是呢。

sentences.en: Stop telling your friends and colleagues I am one, because I'm really not.
sentences.zh: 别再告诉你的朋友和同事我是了，因为我真的还不是。

sentences.en: But I think she's manifesting for me.
sentences.zh: 但我认为她在为我显化这个目标。

sentences.en: And we've got there in the end.
sentences.zh: 我们最终还是做到了。

sentences.en: But yeah, third year trying.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是第三次尝试。

sentences.en: But I really do feel like it's the right time.
sentences.zh: 但我真的觉得现在是合适的时机。

sentences.en: And last year, it would have been a very, very challenging year this year if I had have got to play.
sentences.zh: 如果我去年就入选了，今年将会是非常、非常具有挑战性的一年。

sentences.en: So sorry to hear about the loss of your mum.
sentences.zh: 听到你母亲去世的消息，我深表遗憾。

sentences.en: You know, having lost my dad, I know what a derailing process that is.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我也失去了父亲，我知道那是一个多么让人崩溃的过程。

sentences.en: But also, you're younger than me as well.
sentences.zh: 而且你比我年轻。

sentences.en: And so you, you know, you hope and expect to hold on to your parents for a little bit longer.
sentences.zh: 所以你会希望并期待能多陪伴父母一段时间。

sentences.en: And it might be timely to mention a charity that I mentioned recently, but they can never get enough mentions, really.
sentences.zh: 也许现在提一下我最近提到的一个慈善机构很合适，但它们确实值得更多的关注。

sentences.en: So if anybody listening to this has lost a parent, you know, younger than 30, basically, do check out the charity called It's Time.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果收听节目的任何人失去了父母，而且是在30岁之前，请务必查看名为“It's Time”的慈善机构。

sentences.en: I think on Instagram, they're It's Time Charity.
sentences.zh: 我想在Instagram上，他们的名字是“It's Time Charity”。

sentences.en: But if you're watching on YouTube, there will be details in the on screen.
sentences.zh: 如果你在YouTube上观看，屏幕上会有详细信息。

sentences.en: And if you're listening, it will be in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 如果你在收听，节目说明里也会有。

sentences.en: But it's very unique to lose a parent so young.
sentences.zh: 在如此年轻的时候失去父母是非常独特的经历。

sentences.en: And it does affect us.
sentences.zh: 这确实会影响我们。

sentences.en: And especially, you know, given that you had a long journey with her illness as well,
sentences.zh: 特别是考虑到你和她患病期间经历的漫长旅程，

sentences.en: that shapes us and leaves its impact on your childhood and your young adulthood in a way that is just, if you haven't had those difficulties, others, you know,
sentences.zh: 这塑造了我们，并在你的童年和青年时期留下了印记，如果你没有经历过这些困难，其他人可能无法理解那是什么感觉。

sentences.en: perhaps don't realise what it's like to have had that.
sentences.zh: 所以我向你致以最深切的慰问。

sentences.en: So sending you my deepest condolences.
sentences.zh: 你妈妈听起来确实是一个不可思议的灵魂。

sentences.en: Your mum does sound like an incredible soul.
sentences.zh: 我听过你参与的她的一期播客。

sentences.en: And, you know, I've listened to one of her podcast episodes that you were in.
sentences.zh: 她听起来有着美妙的精神，充满活力。

sentences.en: And she's just, you know, she sounds like she's got just a wonderful, had a wonderful spirit, a real energy about her.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 她照亮了每一个房间。

sentences.en: She's just, yeah, lit up every room.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 我们今天谈话的原因是，我记得在我父亲去世后不久，我正在考虑进行EMDR培训，有人告诉我：

sentences.en: And, you know, the reason for us talking today really is I remember when shortly after my dad died and I was looking at doing some training in EMDR and I was told, you know,
sentences.zh: 也许现在对你来说不是合适的时机。

sentences.en: maybe it's not the right time for you.
sentences.zh: 你知道，处理所有这些事情，还有你那个不睡觉的年幼孩子，这显然是一个非常棘手的时期，你还要兼顾很多事情。

sentences.en: You know, with all of that stuff and, you know, with your young child who's not sleeping and it's obviously a really tricky time and you're juggling a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 我当时跟我的一位朋友兼同事提过，说我今年打算放弃培训，我们是同期受训的。

sentences.en: And I kind of mentioned, oh, I'm going to give it a miss this year to my to my friend and colleague who we trained at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我们曾同时担任助理，但在不同的课程中。

sentences.en: We were assistants at the same time, but we were on different courses.
sentences.zh: 她当时说：什么？

sentences.en: And she was like, what?
sentences.zh: 这绝对不是错误的时机。

sentences.en: It's totally not the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 你会喜欢这个的，它会让你充满活力，帮助你找到你的“为什么”和你的目标。

sentences.en: You're going to love this and it's going to help energize you and it's going to help give you your why and give you your purpose.
sentences.zh: 她坚持说：一定要做，一定要做。

sentences.en: She was like, definitely, definitely do it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这对你来说会很棒。

sentences.en: Like, I think this is going to be great for you.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她是正确的。

sentences.en: And actually, she was right.
sentences.zh: 她是正确的。

sentences.en: She was right.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果我没有某种专长或某种“东西”，我想我不会有信心开始我的生意。

sentences.en: And actually, I don't think I would have had the confidence to start my business if I didn't have like a specialty or like a thing.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个专长，虽然我们往往不需要，因为我们本身就足够好了。

sentences.en: Like, you know, you need a thing and often we don't need a thing because we're enough as we are.
sentences.zh: 也许我从来不需要什么专长，但我觉得在完成了EMDR培训后，加上博士学位、硕士学位、本科学位，以及多年的临床实践，我感到足够被认可了。

sentences.en: And maybe I never needed a thing, but I feel like having done the EMDR that I felt validated enough, as well as the doctorate and the masters and the undergrad, you know,
sentences.zh: 我需要一个额外的专长来让自己觉得物有所值。

sentences.en: and the years of clinical practice.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个很长的故事，贾兹，但我很高兴我在那个时候做了我所做的事情。

sentences.en: I needed an extra thing to feel like I was offering value for money.
sentences.zh: 这确实很棘手，我在培训期间确实哭过，因为我们知道，而且你应该做好准备的是，所有的路往往都会通向悲伤。

sentences.en: So I also, that was a very long story, Jazz, but I'm delighted that I did what I did when I did it.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在进行任何形式的治疗实践，你只需要拉动一根小线，你就会触碰到它。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was tricky and I did end up crying during my training because what we know and what you should be prepared for is that often all roads lead to grief.
sentences.zh: 但没关系，情绪化是可以的。

sentences.en: So if you're doing any sort of therapy practice, you know, you only need to pull a small thread and then and then you'll get there.
sentences.zh: 我想我们不一定希望你在与客户的治疗中哭泣，但我认为我们在学习如何治愈他人的同时，也在进行一些重要的自我疗愈。

sentences.en: But it's OK, you know, to be emotional.
sentences.zh: 所以告诉我，这让你想到了什么？

sentences.en: I guess we don't want you crying in sessions with clients necessarily, but I think we do some important healing whilst we're trying to learn how to heal others, too.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，有没有人对你说过，也许你应该哀悼一年，明年再继续培训？

sentences.en: So tell me what that evokes for you.
sentences.zh: 有没有人说过这可能不是你的时机，或者相反？

sentences.en: Tell me, had people said to you, maybe, you know, maybe grieve for a year, get on with training next year.
sentences.zh: 你的经历是什么样的？

sentences.en: You know, maybe this isn't your time or all the opposite.
sentences.zh: 是的，你提到你朋友说“去吧，去做吧”，这很有趣，因为我也遇到过类似的情况。

sentences.en: What was your experience?
